name: CATOPIA
summary:
Step into the shoes of your adorable cat avatar, customize its appearance, and get ready for thrilling escapades. Use your magical hands to navigate the environment, climb, scratch, and pounce just like a real cat. Interact with the town's residents and form lasting friendships.
In Catopia you can also express your personal style by dressing up your feline character in a variety of cute and quirky outfits. Be the most fashionable cat on the block and show off your unique sense of style.
